title: •Ambush
caption: •Ambush (V)
game_text_lines:
Use 1 Force to ▼ up to two clones. OR If your
clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your
control phase, use 2 Force (free if at Coruscant) to
retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in
battle, add one battle destiny.
lore: “Well done. Hold them in the security tower, and keep it quiet. Move.”

notes: Group: Rescue The Chancellor. Normal bottom-half slip (756×454), red Interrupt frame, banner LOST INTERRUPT (as printed). Unique (•Ambush, as printed). Text: ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; three 'OR' clauses in one paragraph. Right margin above the VS16 sphere: a black EPISODE I disc → icons ['episode1'] (the printed Cloud City card has none; the VB5 reissue shows it in the same place). Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from the scan: double curly quotes “…” (wiki has straight single quotes). Base scan 350 px; Cloud City 1997 by rule (not legible). Modern: VB5-L-ambush-pre.gif (350).
